==Description==
'''VIP+''' is a subscription for Tower Defense Simulator. Its base cost is {{Robux|449}} every month, and is dynamically priced based on factors such as the purchasing country.

When '''VIP+''' is renewed, a pop up message will appear when joining the game for the first time, informing the player of this.

==Perks==
*75% more {{Exp|}}.
*20% more {{Coins|Coins}} and {{Gem|Gems}}.
*In-game friends receive a 10% {{Exp|}}, {{Coins|Coins}} and {{Gem|Gems}} buff.
*Better odds for crate items.
*[[VIPPlus Nametag]].
*Custom chat tag that displays [VIP+] to the left of the username.
*Increases the limit for tower pets to five.

===First Time Rewards===
*One [[Deluxe Crate]].
*Four [[High Grade Crate]]s.
*Ten {{TimeScaleTicket|Time Scale Tickets}}.
*{{Coins|5,000}}.

===Reccurring Rewards===
*One [[Deluxe Crate]].
*Four [[High Grade Crate]]s.
*Ten {{TimeScaleTicket|Time Scale Tickets}}.
